description: This file is a PHP script demonstrating an example of using PEAR Auth with ADOdb for user authentication. It includes a form for login and initializes authentication using ADOdb and PEAR Auth classes.

classes.name: Auth
classes.description: A class from the PEAR Auth package used to handle authentication, initialized with parameters for database connection and authentication methods.

methods.name: loginFunction
methods.description: Outputs a simple HTML form for user login, submitting username and password via POST to the same script for authentication.
